description: PATCH /v1/merchants/me - update the business name shown to payers and/or the account-level service-fee payer; each field is independent, send only what changes. Setting the name for the first time flips onboardingCompleted to true. The profile email is not updatable: it is taken from the verified thirdweb login email and never overwritten.

name.description: Business name shown to payers on the checkout page.

serviceFeePayer.description: Account-level service-fee payer: MERCHANT withholds the fee from proceeds, PAYER adds it to the payer's amount due. New sessions inherit it unless sessions_create overrides it.

name: merchant_update
title: Update merchant profile
